editorialIntent: A country-neutral practical planning, launch and maintenance guide for restaurant and cafe owners commissioning their first website. Three independently drafted editions with the same verified facts, different openings and section flow.
keywordMethod: Qualitative live search-result and owner-question research in English, Hebrew and Greek. No Keyword Planner, Search Console export or paid volume dataset was available; these are intent targets, not measured demand or ranking predictions.

researchEvidence.purpose: Primary hospitality platform: guest tasks and website planning; no quoted cost figures or conversion claims.
No special Google AI markup or guaranteed inclusion.
Relevance, distance and prominence for local ranking.
Business Profile can show menus; do not claim Google cannot answer basic restaurant questions.
Visible business facts and supported local-business markup; article itself remains BlogPosting.
Descriptive filenames, localized alt text, image context, image discovery.
Actual menu text rather than image-only text.
Do not sell FAQ rich results for a commercial studio article. No FAQPage advertising markup added.

cannibalization.newIntent: Country-neutral first-website commissioning checklist, studio comparison, launch and ongoing operations.
cannibalization.boundary: No country keyword targeting, duplicate local landing pages or invented demand claims. Existing service and pricing pages retain commercial intent. The short social comparison supports the planning decision; it is not the new article's primary target.

claimsReview: No unlimited updates, fixed delivery dates, guaranteed rankings, invented customer results or e-commerce promises.
Concept projects identified honestly; imagery is illustrative, not a real client venue.
Question-led HTML headings are visible without accordions. No FAQPage markup for promotional content.

assets.mode: Built-in image_gen, revised after user feedback

publishing: Preview only. Production article canonicals are prepared for eventual approved release; Vercel Preview must retain noindex headers.
